description: Set 3: set 1 with rho_base and chi_0 NOT declared. ILLUSTRATIVE. A grooved ramp propped on a table, four pencil marks P1-P4 along it. The observable at each mark is its height above the tabletop, read on a 300 mm ruler. A marble released above P1 is observed to roll past P1, P2, P3, P4 in that order. These values are supplied demonstration data, NOT an observation.

persistence.process_entry: Each declaration is one static set of height readings. The evaluation record begins with this set; no earlier set of this ramp has been admitted, and no sequence of observations is declared.

regional_prerequisite.orientation_preserved: the height of each mark above the tabletop, in mm, as read on the ruler
regional_prerequisite.orientation_discarded: everything else about the marks and the ramp: position along the ramp, width of the pencil line, the marble's speed, reading uncertainty
regional_prerequisite.admission_rule_description: A height reading is admitted into evaluation only when it lies on the ruler's printed scale, 0 mm to 300 mm inclusive.

mappings.name: m.lesson1.identity
mappings.input_description: a height reading in mm, as written in the declaration
mappings.output_description: the same value in D, in mm
mappings.preserves: the height reading of each mark in mm
mappings.discards: everything about the mark except its height reading

edges.description: illustrative: the marble is observed to roll from mark P1 directly to mark P2 along the one continuous groove, with no other mark between them; direction is the observed direction of travel
illustrative: the marble is observed to roll from mark P2 directly to mark P3 along the one continuous groove, with no other mark between them; direction is the observed direction of travel
illustrative: the marble is observed to roll from mark P3 directly to mark P4 along the one continuous groove, with no other mark between them; direction is the observed direction of travel

interior_loci.basis: illustrative: the marble is observed arriving at P2 from P1 and continuing from P2 to P3
illustrative: the marble is observed arriving at P3 from P2 and continuing from P3 to P4

lesson.kernel_selection_basis: illustrative: P2 and P3 each have an observed incoming and an observed continuing relation, so M establishes interior loci (kernel_reference.md §10)
lesson.detection_tolerance_basis: implementation-only numerical tolerance for finite-precision arithmetic (kernel_reference.md §11.5); not a property of the ramp
